newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nail not interested in Gold Fields.
newsitem.headline: Nail not interested in Gold Fields.

text.p: Black empowerment business group New Africa Investments Ltd (Nail) is not interested in acquiring Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd, Business Report newspaper said on Monday.
"I deny emphatically that we are interested in Gold Fields," the paper quoted Cyril Ramaphosa, deputy executive chairman of Nail, as saying.
"We don't want Gold Fields. We are once bitten, twice shy about gold. There are other more exciting sectors, like information technology, to look at."

He was responding to a report in the British Financial Times which said he and Rembrandt Group chairman Johann Rupert had held long discussions about plans to take black investors on board as Gold Fields investors. Rembrandt has a pivotal role in control of the mining house.
A consortium led by Nail last year lost the bid for Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd's stake in another mining house and gold producer, JCI Ltd.
